description_en: Queries the specifications of a specific Anti-DDoS Origin instance
description_zh: 查询指定的DDoS原生防护实例的规格信息
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp describe-instance-specs --instance-id-list ddosbgp-cn-n6w1r7nz0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstanceSpecs

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance. This parameter is a string that consists of JSON arrays. Each element in a JSON array indicates an instance ID. If you want to query more than one instance, separate instance IDs with commas (,).

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html operation to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances in a specific region
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的ID。使用JSON数组转化的字符串格式表示。JSON数组中的每个元素表示一个实例ID（字符串格式），多个ID间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html查询指定地域下所有DDoS原生防护实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id_list

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance. Default value: cn-hangzhou, which indicates the China (Hangzhou) region.

If your instance does not reside in the China (Hangzhou) region, you must set this parameter to the region ID of your instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html operation to query the regions of assets that can be protected by Anti-DDoS Origin in a specific region
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例的地域ID。默认为cn-hangzhou，表示华东1（杭州）。

如果您的实例不在华东1（杭州）地域，则此处必须填写实例所在地域的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询所有的**RegionId**
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs to the default resource group.

For information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

InstanceSpecs.description_en: The specifications of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance, including whether best-effort protection is enabled, the number of available best-effort protection sessions, and the number of used best-effort protection sessions
InstanceSpecs.description_zh: DDoS原生防护实例的规格信息，包含全力防护的开启状态、可用和已用的全力防护次数等

items.description_en: The specifications of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance
items.description_zh: DDoS原生防护实例的规格信息

AvailableDefenseTimes.description_zh: 当前可用的全力防护次数

AvailableDeleteBlackholeCount.description_en: The number of times that blackhole filtering can be deactivated
AvailableDeleteBlackholeCount.description_zh: 当前可用的解除黑洞次数

DefenseTimesPercent.description_en: The percentage of the used best-effort protection sessions. Unit: %
DefenseTimesPercent.description_zh: 全力防护次数使用的百分比。单位：百分比

DowngradeStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is downgraded. Valid value:

8: The instance is downgraded due to excessive bandwidth usage
DowngradeStatus.description_zh:

8：实例因为业务带宽超用被降级

0: Best-effort protection is disabled.
1: Best-effort protection is enabled

该实例是否开启了全力防护模式。取值：

0：未开启全力防护模式。

BindIpCount.description_en: The number of IP addresses that are protected by the Anti-DDoS Origin Enterprise instance

month: the monthly 95th percentile metering method.
day: the daily 95th percentile metering method

IpBasicThre.description_en: The basic protection bandwidth of each protected IP address. Unit: Gbit/s
IpBasicThre.description_zh: 被防护IP的基础防护阈值。单位：Gbps

IpSpec.description_en: The number of IP addresses that can be protected by the Anti-DDoS Origin Enterprise instance

PackAdvThre.description_en: The burstable protection bandwidth of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance. Unit: Gbit/s
PackAdvThre.description_zh: 原生防护实例的弹性防护带宽。单位：Gbps

PackBasicThre.description_en: The basic protection bandwidth of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance. Unit: Gbit/s
PackBasicThre.description_zh: 原生防护实例的基础防护带宽。单位：Gbps

Region.description_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html） operation to query the name of the region
